title: 第2章 果核之王（二）
content_zh:
人鱼的起源，这种奇异的生物是如何进化出在深海生存的能力，并且拥有了类人的——甚至是超过人类的智慧，乃至它们的社会习俗、语言、文字、栖息地，乃至它们创造的文明，至今是一类庞杂超然的谜题。
人类社会唯一能够确定的，就是人鱼不再是一页遐想中的物种，神话里的悬梦，它们真实存在于这颗星球上。正如人类统治陆地一样，数个不为人知的千年翩然擦过，人鱼统治了海洋。
和普世家喻户晓的的传说不同，它们不精巧、不脆弱，无法泣泪成珠，亦不能伴随晨光化作幻美的泡沫。恰恰相反，人鱼是顶级的深海掠食者。它们使用科研人员迄今为止都无法破译的超频声波作为语言，相互沟通交流。
自三十年前，人类第一次目击了人鱼在英吉利海峡出没起，世界各地的研究学者就燃烧着他们狂热的求知欲，为人鱼编篡名录。他们通过人鱼的生存环境、外表形态、食性与族群特征，划分出了十一个可能存在的人鱼王国。
——这其中最神秘、最危险、最与世隔绝的领属，就是栖息在德雷克海峡的人鱼群落，风暴港人鱼。
泰德“嘶”了一声，“这我还真不清楚……不过据我听到的消息，肯定是在远离德雷克海峡的海域。”
“根据第一次的目击录像来推测，拉珀斯在风暴港有着极高的地位，他同时是一位极端排外的族群首领。”江眠沉吟，“他为什么要离开自己的家乡呢？没理由啊……”
德雷克海峡是世界上最危险的航道，人们用海上永不止息的风暴，统称了那里的海底居民。事实上，学术界一直存在的一个争端，那就是风暴港人鱼到底是真实的存在，还是目击者在狂风巨浪的剧烈颠簸中产生的幻觉。
直到十年前，一艘为私企服务的科考船再度穿行德雷克海峡时，风暴港的青铜王嗣忽然就乘着飓浪和海啸的君驾现身了，四周旋转着十余头拱卫它的侍从。
毫无疑问，它看起来怒火滔天，仇憎非常。按照人鱼的年纪来换算，王嗣那时只是一个稚嫩的少年，然而，正是这个“稚嫩的少年”，将千吨重的船身彻底颠覆在了大洋深处。
海面狂涛万丈，每时每刻，都像是有十万个雷霆在苍穹中炸开，在这种压倒性的天灾之下，人类的哀嚎只能沦为最微不足道的东西。船员赤红的鲜血弥漫，撕裂的血肉也弥漫，如何惊心动魄的杀戮，皆在电光火石间逝去，待到风暴停歇，人们最后发现的，唯余舰船的金属残骸，以及四十多具挂在上面，被鱼群用利齿细牙洗劫一空的人类遗骨。
后来，不知出于什么考量，这段本应举世瞩目的惨案被西格玛研究所发动势力压了下去，使它仅在极小的范围内流传，成为一个小圈子的公开秘密。因着江平阳的缘故，江眠也只是隐隐约约地听了一耳朵。
在此之前，从未有过其它领属的人鱼，做出过此等狂暴过激的屠杀行为，因此学者们怀着忌惮和担忧之情，为这条分外仇视闯入者——或者说人类的人鱼掌权者，起了一个血腥的称谓。
“第一，在已知的人鱼样本里，鲜有体长超过三米五的个体，可以推断的唯一一例，就是拉珀斯。他在十年前出现的时候，体型就已经与成年人鱼并肩，十年过去，他只会更大，不会缩水。”江眠匆匆地说，“第二，他被称为青铜王嗣，你有没有想过是为什么？”
泰德不是笨人，他立刻醒悟过来：“它的鳞片花色独一无二，足够独特。”
“没错。”江眠焦躁地吸气，“他们……法比安究竟是怎么做到的？他会引发一场战争的！”
思及此处，泰德心中不免生出了一丝忧虑，又很快被他扑灭。他摇了摇头，说：“你知道的，江，西格玛从不畏惧挑起战争，我们就是战争本身。”
江眠闭上眼睛，他的嘴唇抽动着，看起来很想吐露一些什么东西，到底被他生生压抑住了。
……可我们不是神，他痛苦地想，而挑起战争的人，最终也会死于战争。
“请带我去找法比安吧，”江眠低声说，“这个项目，我可以帮上忙。”

法比安穆勒年逾四十，是研究所当前的掌权人物，不同于江平阳，他是个身材高大，四肢跟头脑一样发达有力的危险人物。江平阳在世时，研究所内的风气还算得上稳健和缓，待到他接任主负责人，短短数月，江眠已然感受到那股压得人喘不过气的激进气氛，向内紧紧拉扯着他的皮肤。
“这么说，江先生终于想通了？”法比安转过身来看着他，手中漫不经心地转着一根精钢的指挥手杖，“看来，江先生之所以不理会我前几个月的提议，是因为我还没有真正做出点成绩，所以说服不了你啊。”
江眠不接他的茬，问：“拉珀斯绝不是一个好对付的目标，你到底是怎么做到的？”
法比安好笑地盯着他，反问道：“这重要吗？只要结果足够出色，谁还会管过程如何？”
他慢悠悠地走近江眠，缓步绕到他身后。他挨得非常近，衣料摩挲的声音器清晰可闻，吹在脖颈后方的呼吸亦鲜明得叫人起鸡皮疙瘩，江眠强忍着肌肤上的刺痛感，只是站着一动不动。
content_en:
The origin of mermaids, how this strange creature evolved the ability to survive in the deep sea, and possessed human-like or even superhuman intelligence, as well as their social customs, language, writing, habitat, and even the civilization they created, are still a complex and transcendent mystery.
The only thing that human society can be sure of is that mermaids are no longer a species in fantasy, a hanging dream in mythology, they really exist on this planet. Just as humans ruled the land, several unknown millennia passed by and merfolk ruled the seas.
Unlike the universally known legends, they are not exquisite, not fragile, cannot weep into tears, nor can they turn into beautiful bubbles with the morning light. On the contrary, mermaids are the apex deep-sea predators. They communicate with each other using superfrequency sound waves that scientific researchers have not been able to decipher so far as a language.
Since the first sighting of mermaids in the English Channel thirty years ago, researchers from all over the world have been burning with their fanatical curiosity to compile a list of mermaids. They classified eleven possible mermaid kingdoms based on their living environment, appearance, feeding habits and group characteristics.
——The most mysterious, dangerous, and isolated territory among them is the mermaid community that lives in the Drake Strait, the Storm Harbor Mermaids.
Ted hissed, "I really don't know this...but according to the news I heard, it must be in the sea far away from the Drake Strait."
"Based on the first witness video, it is speculated that Rapace has a very high status in Storm Harbor. He is also an extremely xenophobic leader of the ethnic group." Jiang Mian pondered, "Why did he leave his hometown? There is no reason..."
The Drake Passage is the most dangerous waterway in the world. People refer to the never-ending storms at sea as the underwater inhabitants there. In fact, there has always been a dispute in the academic community, that is, whether the mermaids of Storm Harbor are real or whether they are hallucinations produced by witnesses in the violent turbulence of strong winds and waves.
Until ten years ago, when a scientific research ship serving a private enterprise passed through the Drake Strait again, the bronze heir of Stormport suddenly appeared on the chariot of hurricane waves and tsunamis, with more than ten attendants rotating around to protect it.
There is no doubt that it looks furious and hateful. Calculated by the age of the mermaid, Wang Si was just a young boy at that time. However, it was this "young boy" who completely overturned the thousand-ton ship in the depths of the ocean.
The sea is raging, and every moment, it seems like a hundred thousand thunders are exploding in the sky. Under this overwhelming natural disaster, the wailing of human beings can only be reduced to the most insignificant thing. The red blood of the crew filled the air, as did the torn flesh. The thrilling killings all passed in a flash of lightning. When the storm subsided, the last thing people discovered was the metal wreckage of the ship, and more than forty human remains hanging on it, which had been looted by the fish with their sharp teeth.
Later, for unknown reasons, this tragic incident that should have attracted worldwide attention was suppressed by the forces mobilized by the Sigma Research Institute. It was only circulated within a very small range and became an open secret in a small circle. Because of Jiang Pingyang, Jiang Mian only listened vaguely.
Before this, no mermaid from other territories had ever committed such a violent and violent act of massacre. Therefore, with fear and worry, scholars gave this mermaid a bloody name for the intruder who was particularly hostile to the intruder - or in other words, the mermaid leader.
"First, among the known mermaid samples, there are very few individuals with a body length exceeding three and a half meters. The only one that can be inferred is Rapace. When he appeared ten years ago, his size was already comparable to that of an adult fish. Ten years later, he will only grow bigger and will not shrink." Jiang Mian said hurriedly, "The firstSecond, he is called the Bronze King Heir. Have you ever thought about why? "
Ted was not stupid, and he immediately realized: "The color of its scales is unique and unique enough. "
"That's right. Jiang Mian inhaled anxiously, "They...how did Fabian do it?" He will start a war! "
Thinking about this, Ted couldn't help but feel a little worried in his heart, but he quickly put it out. He shook his head and said: "You know, Jiang, Sigma is never afraid of provoking war, we are the war itself. "
Jiang Mian closed his eyes, and his lips twitched, as if he wanted to reveal something, but he was suppressing it.
...But we are not gods, he thought painfully, and those who start wars will eventually die in wars.
"Please take me to Fabian," Jiang Mian whispered, "I can help with this project. "
Fabian Muller is over forty years old and is the current powerful figure in the institute. Unlike Jiang Pingyang, he is a tall and dangerous man with limbs as developed and powerful as his mind. When Jiang Pingyang was alive, the atmosphere in the institute was relatively stable and gentle. When he took over as the person in charge, within just a few months, Jiang Mian had already felt the overwhelming and radical atmosphere, pulling his skin tightly inwards.
"So, Mr. Jiang finally figured it out? Fabian turned around and looked at him, twirling a fine steel command cane carelessly in his hand, "It seems that the reason why Mr. Jiang ignored my suggestions in the past few months is because I haven't really made any achievements yet, so I can't convince you." "
Jiang Mian refused to answer his question and asked, "Rapus is definitely not an easy target to deal with. How did you do it? "
Fabian stared at him funny and asked: "Is this important? As long as the results are great enough, who cares about the process? "
He slowly approached Jiang Mian and slowly walked around behind him. He was so close that the sound of his clothes rubbing against his skin was clearly audible, and his breath on the back of his neck was so vivid that it gave rise to goosebumps. Jiang Mian resisted the tingling sensation on his skin and just stood motionless.
